fields.statement: Verified at 1df154a8. `go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-worktree-carries-accept` passes. The script commits a proposed change set with leaves, accepts it in the main clone (entry untracked), starts `rhiza run start --foreground` in a new worktree, then a second change set with its worktree reused on its branch, accepted between runs. In each, `change show` reports accepted, the accept entry is present and untracked, `rhiza ship land` lands with a clean tree, and the accept entry file is in the pushed branch's tree on the bare origin. With internal/api/session.go reverted to 5ca57f63, the script fails at line 39 (worktree reports proposed), so it covers the fix. Diff read: worktreeWorkspace now copies the main clone's change set entries whenever the main clone has that change set's log, never overwriting (copyNewFile), then reopens. `go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api/... -skip TestReadBudget` passes. TestReadBudget failed timing budgets (different reads each run) at 1df154a8 and equally at the base 5ca57f63 under load average 6-14; it times read paths this change does not touch, so the failure was there before this change and comes from machine load.
